label: Town of Poultney
header:
# Town of Poultney municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 18; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 133 (Town of Poultney): section 304 provides for a Moderator elected for a one-year term

Town of Poultney, 2025 Town Report (poultneyvt.gov), 'Elected Town Officers' table submitted by Betsy J. Wescott, Town Clerk lists Moderator Jaime Lee with a one-year term expiring on Town Meeting Day 2026. No official source publishes the 2026 moderator outcome, so the post is created without a membership
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 133 (Town of Poultney): section 303: the Selectboard has five members -- three on staggered three-year terms and two on one-year terms

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Poultney's five selectboard members: Valerie Broughton, Alan-Glen Burnell (Vice Chair), John "Jay" Morgan, Sheryl Porrier (Chair), and Abigail Teetor

Town of Poultney, Selectboard page (poultneyvt.gov): the current board roster with term expirations lists Sheryl Porrier (Chair, term to 2029 -- she won the three-year seat in 2026), Alan-Glen Burnell (Vice Chair, 2028), Abigail Teetor (2027), Jay Morgan (2027), and one seat 'Vacant' (2027)

Town of Poultney, 'Selectboard Notice of Vacancy -- September 2026': the town sought letters of interest (due September 21, 2026) to fill a Selectboard vacancy 'for the remainder of a term ending on March 2, 2027' -- Valerie Broughton's three-year seat; the seat was still shown vacant on the board page when read, so it is created without a membership
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 133 (Town of Poultney): section 304(a): the Town Clerk is elected for a three-year term

Town of Poultney, 2025 Town Report (poultneyvt.gov), 'Elected Town Officers' table submitted by Betsy J. Wescott, Town Clerk lists Town Clerk Betsy J. Wescott with a three-year term expiring on Town Meeting Day 2026

Town of Poultney, Town Clerk & Treasurer page (poultneyvt.gov): the town's current page for the office names Betsy Wescott. Her terms expired in 2026 and the town presents her as the sitting clerk; she is recorded as re-elected on this incumbent-continuity reading, disclosed on issue #163
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 133 (Town of Poultney): section 304(d): the Town Treasurer is elected for a three-year term

Town of Poultney, 2025 Town Report (poultneyvt.gov), 'Elected Town Officers' table submitted by Betsy J. Wescott, Town Clerk lists Town Treasurer Betsy J. Wescott with a three-year term expiring on Town Meeting Day 2026

Town of Poultney, Town Clerk & Treasurer page (poultneyvt.gov): the town's current page for the office names Betsy Wescott; she is recorded as re-elected on the same incumbent-continuity reading as the clerkship
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 133 (Town of Poultney): sections 302(1) and 304(c): five library trustees on five-year terms, one elected each year

Town of Poultney, 2025 Town Report (poultneyvt.gov), 'Elected Town Officers' table submitted by Betsy J. Wescott, Town Clerk lists library trustees Jean S. Davis (term to 2027), D. Bruce Williams (2028), Ennis Duling (2029), Nancy Luzer (2030), and Emily Sosnoff (2026). The seat that stood in 2026 (Sosnoff's) has no published outcome, so it is created without a membership
